exposure: Lung ultrasound scores (LUS) on days 3, 7, and 14 after birth
cohort: A total of 152 infants less than 29 weeks of gestational age, with a mean gestational age of 25.8 (1.5) weeks.
finding: Lung ultrasound scores (LUS) in the first 2 weeks after birth had a very high predictive value for the diagnosis of bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) among infants less than 29 weeks of gestation.
